errors.description: jtag_shift_q is a multi-bit value produced in jtag_clk and sampled directly in system_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
update_pulse_q is a one-cycle jtag_clk pulse consumed directly in system_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
update_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample system_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in system_event_o.
tap_state_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector tap_state_q before decoding in system_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
jtag_rst_n is used as data inside system_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
trace_snapshot_q combines jtag_clk payload state with system_clk status state in trace_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
